responsibility: This Autoconf input script defines the host-configuration probes for the gm2-libs runtime support library. It belongs to the build/configuration subsystem rather than the executable runtime, checking for required headers, C library functions, select argument types, math-library features, struct timeval availability, and type sizes, then driving generation of gm2-libs-host.h so the Modula-2 runtime wrappers can adapt to the capabilities of the build host.
